subject.title: feat(ui): match ClickClack discussion sidebars to host themes

question: Should this host-side PR wait for the ClickClack first-paint custom-token receiver follow-up, or is a staged rollout without that advertised behavior acceptable?
rationale: The PR changes an interoperating cross-origin protocol across repositories, and the intended first-paint custom-palette result cannot be established from the sender-side mock alone.

options.title: Sequence with the receiver
options.body: Merge or otherwise make the ClickClack token receiver available first, then prove the complete two-origin flow before landing this PR.

options.title: Stage light/dark only
options.body: Narrow this PR and its user-facing claim to the receiver behavior already deployed, leaving custom first-paint tokens for a coordinated follow-up.

options.title: Accept a coordinated rollout risk
options.body: Land the sender before the receiver only if maintainers explicitly accept temporary custom-palette mismatch during rollout.

recommendation.title: Sequence with the receiver
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise make the ClickClack token receiver available first, then prove the complete two-origin flow before landing this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context places this contributor at the coordination point between the host Control UI change and the referenced ClickClack receiver work.
